actual_images_inspected.findings: Two storeys, horizontal wood siding, bracketed cornice, ornamented upper sash surrounds, large lower shopfront openings. Automobile and steel bridge structure are visible.
actual_images_inspected.date_issue: Oregon Encyclopedia caption says circa 1895, but visible features raise a later-date concern. Do not repeat circa 1895 as a verified photograph date. Do not assign the separate 1941 catalog date to this image without a match.
actual_images_inspected.limits: No hues, original roof material, original shopfront form or 1890s plan established by this monochrome view.

actual_images_inspected.findings: Two- and three-story commercial frontages, projecting cornices, arched openings, raised sidewalks and a worked street surface.
actual_images_inspected.limits: General architectural/setting context; does not identify a crimp establishment or reveal paint hues.

decisions: No new model or render before a claim-specific architecture/material/colour brief is complete.
Use a clearly fictional establishment; no invented biography or accusation against pictured people or charitable lodging institutions.
No tunnel entrance, kidnapping apparatus or other unsupported distinctive prop.
The canonical Crimp House ability remains game mechanics, not a factual description of crimping.
Reference images stay in research; not embedded as textures or presented as game art.
remaining: Resolve a suitable period architectural basis, using the 1874 streetscape or a separately documented lodging-house type if the Boss building date remains uncertain.
Document facade paint/material colours, roofing and river-margin setting before authoring.
Prepare the factual three-line History note and explicit reconstruction limits.
